children: Endovia Health Sciences entered into a Letter Agreement with C/M Capital Master Fund, which includes an initial $510,000 secured convertible note and a minimum $1 million total investment commitment. The note carries a $576,271 principal after original issue discount, matures on September 18, 2027, and converts at the lower of $1.75 per share or $0.01 above the market price at conversion. It bears no interest unless in default and allows prepayment at any time, with mandatory prepayments tied to proceeds from the company's existing equity line. The financing is intended to advance regulatory, clinical, and commercialization plans for CannEpil.
